fields.Name: Collaboration Space Chat Audience
fields.Description: Returns the allowed bands (Shared, or Shared + Team for Private/Internal) derived from PrimaryScopeRecordID.
fields.SQL:
SELECT 'Shared' AS Band
FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceChat] sc
WHERE (sc.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR sc.ConversationID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))
  AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Team' AS Band
FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceChat] sc
WHERE (sc.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR sc.ConversationID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))
  AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36
  AND sc.Kind = 'Private'

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Shared' AS Band
FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
WHERE s.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
  AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceChat] sc
      WHERE sc.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
  )
